nodes.name: 01-stripe-backend.md
nodes.summary: Recon document auditing the existing Stripe/billing backend state for the PR7 build, inventorying real vs fabricated surfaces in the local Fastify sidecar, webhook tier-flipping, price env contract, and PCI implications of a custom card form.

nodes.name: 02-auth-session.md
nodes.summary: Recon document mapping the current accountless auth and session model (per-process device token, no identity) against what PR7 must add via Clerk, cataloguing real vs must-build surfaces and open architectural decisions.

nodes.name: 03-screen-auth-design.md
nodes.summary: Detailed design specification for Screen 13 (Auth / Clerk themed), including exact split-panel layout, every view-state (sign-in, sign-up, verify OTP, SSO), warm-token CSS mapping, and a honesty contract listing fabrication risks that must be gated off.

nodes.name: 04-screen-billing-design.md
nodes.summary: Detailed design specification for Screen 14 (Billing / Stripe), covering four states (Plans, Checkout, Success, Manage), verbatim copy from the HTML prototype, fabrication-risk register distinguishing real Stripe-backed surfaces from must-gate items, and recommended PR7 build shape.

nodes.name: 05-clerk-integration.md
nodes.summary: Architecture verdict and integration guide for adding optional Clerk auth to the local-first desktop app, detailing ClerkProvider placement, warm CSS token theming of prebuilt components, the optional-account pattern, and fabrication risks to gate off.

nodes.name: 06-routing-surfaces.md
nodes.summary: Routing and surface registration recon for PR7, detailing how /auth (full-screen pre-shell sibling route) and /billing (Settings Plan-tab deep-link) must be wired into App.tsx and the command catalog, including breadcrumb label gaps and existing upgrade entry-points.

nodes.name: 07-byo-vs-metered.md
nodes.summary: Founder decision document analysing the BYO-key (flat subscription) vs Waggle-metered inference-cost model for PR7, presenting evidence from the shipped PR5 BYO-key implementation and existing flat Stripe tiers, with a concrete recommendation and open sub-decisions.
